The HF118F 012-11ZS1 decodes as a specific miniature high-power electromagnetic PCB relay manufactured by Hongfa. It is widely used in compact electronic modules, home appliances, and industrial controls.

• Contact Rating: 10A at 250VAC / 30VDC.
• Coil Resistance: 620 Ω (with a low power consumption of approximately 220mW).
• Must-Operate Voltage: Max 8.4V DC.
• Must-Release Voltage: Min 1.2V DC.
• Dielectric Strength: 5,000 VAC between coil and contacts (reinforced insulation meeting VDE standards).
• Dimensions: 28.5 mm × 10.1 mm × 12.5 mm.
• Contact Material: Silver Tin Oxide (AgSnO2) for enhanced electrical endurance and resistance to welding.
